subject: Model Context Protocol 2026-07-28 final specification and stable SDK migration boundary

selection.reason: The MCP 2026-07-28 specification moved from release candidate to an immutable stable tag with a versioned schema and stable Go and TypeScript SDK releases. Direct RC-to-final schema comparison exposes an interoperability-relevant identity-field change, while exact SDK documentation supports a scoped deployment decision about negotiation, legacy fallback, server entry points, and conformance pinning.

signals.note: Reviewed recent OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Meta AI, GitHub Copilot, Moonshot AI, and MCP official announcement and release surfaces before opening primary artifacts.
Reviewed recent GitHub Changelog, VS Code, NVIDIA, AMD, MLCommons, vLLM, and SGLang surfaces. Search summaries and vendor marketing were not used as article evidence.

Reviewed accessible X search surfaces for recent signals from frontier researchers and MCP maintainers, including Andrej Karpathy, Ilya Sutskever, Jim Fan, and David Soria Parra queries. Current direct posts were incomplete or not material to the selected claim, so no X post or X-generated summary is used as article evidence.
